summary_en: Wacoal Holdings authorized acquisition of up to 5.50 million shares (11.1% of outstanding shares) for up to 20.0 billion yen over the period from November 13, 2026 to November 12, 2027. The company will simultaneously cancel 2.50 million treasury shares on November 20, 2026. The program aims to enhance shareholder returns and improve capital efficiency.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On November 12, 2026, Wacoal Holdings' board of directors authorized a share buyback program and treasury stock cancellation. The company will acquire up to 5.50 million shares of its common stock, representing 11.1% of the 49.49 million outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock as of October 31, 2026), for a maximum of 20.0 billion yen. The acquisition period runs from November 13, 2026 through November 12, 2027. The acquisition will be conducted through market purchases at prices determined by market conditions during the designated period.

Concurrently, Wacoal Holdings will cancel 2.50 million treasury shares held as of October 31, 2026 on November 20, 2026. This cancellation will reduce the total outstanding share count from the current 49.49 million shares.

The company cited two primary objectives for this program: enhancing shareholder returns and improving capital efficiency. This balanced approach—combining buybacks with concurrent cancellation of existing treasury shares—reflects management's commitment to optimizing the capital structure while returning value to shareholders.
